en:
Swordsman Newsletter {Symbol:10}1
    Some Walls Go Boom...
It may look like a regular wall, but
it may be something you can blow up.
There's actually an easy way to tell.
And I'm here to teach you!
{Color:Blue}Build up the power in your sword and
start stabbing the wall.{Color:White}
If you pay attention, you'll find that
some spots make a different sound!
{Choice:03:0A}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Sermirsky zpravodaj {Symbol:10}1
    Nektere zdi delaji bum...
Muze to vypadat jako bezna zed, ale
muze to byt neco, co lze vyhodit.
Existuje snadny zpusob, jak to poznat.
A ja te to naucim!
{Color:Blue}Nabij mec silou a
zacni do zdi bodat.{Color:White}
Kdyz dobre poslouchas, zjistis, ze
nektera mista zni jinak!
{Choice:03:0A}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To stací

en:
Teach us, Teacher!
Monsters got you?
Don't give up! {Color:Blue}Start mashing buttons!{Color:White}
You might be able to escape quickly!
{Choice:03:0B}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Nauc nas, ucitelı!
Chytlo te monstrum?
Nevzdavej to! {Color:Blue}Mackej tlacitka!{Color:White}
Mozna se ti podari rychle uniknout!
{Choice:03:0B}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Swiftblade's Gossip Column
The Magical Boomerang...
Somewhere in Hyrule, you can find an
incredibly handy {Color:Red}boomerang{Color:White}.
It's designed so you can change its
direction after you throw it!
Or so I've been told.
But it's just a rumor...
{Choice:03:0C}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Swiftbladuv drbarsky kout
Kouzelny bumerang...
Nekde v Hyrule najdes neuveritelne
sikovny {Color:Red}bumerang{Color:White}.
Je vyrobeny tak, ze muzes menit
jeho smer i po hodu!
Nebo mi to aspon rekli.
Ale je to jen drb...
{Choice:03:0C}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Swiftblade, Signing Off!
That's it for our first issue!
We plan to bring you helpful questing
hints every week, rain or shine.
Be sure to check with your local
post office for future issues!
See you in issue 2!
Until next time, warriors!
cz:
Swiftblade se louci!
A to je vse z naseho prvniho cisla!
Kazdy tyden ti prineseme uzitecne
tipy na vypravy, at prsi nebo svıti.
Urcite se stav na mistni poste
kvuli dalsim cislum!
Uvidime se v cisle 2!
Do prıste, valecnici!

en:
Swordsman Newsletter {Symbol:10}2
    This Year's Must-Have Item!
Have you seen those sparks that move
along walls?
Your sword doesn't work, so maybe
you've just given up fighting them.
But have you tried ALL your items?
Like...what about your boomerang?
Give that a shot! You might be
surprised at the results!
{Choice:03:0E}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Sermirsky zpravodaj {Symbol:10}2
    Letosni must-have predmet!
Videl jsi ty jiskry, co se pohybuji
podel zdi?
Mec na ne nefunguje, takze jsi
mozna boj s nimi vzdal.
Ale zkousel jsi VSECHNY predmety?
Napriklad...co tak bumerang?
Zkus to! Mozna te vysledek
prekvapi!
{Choice:03:0E}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Teach us, Teacher!
Monster took your shield?
Well, don't get all down about it.
All hope is not lost.
Beat him up quickly, and you might
just get it back!
{Choice:03:0F}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Nauc nas, ucitelı!
Vzala ti netvor stıt?
No, nesvesuj kvuli tomu hlavu.
Nadeje neni ztracena.
Rychle ho zmlat a treba
ho dostanes zpatky!
{Choice:03:0F}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Swiftblade's Gossip Column
The Mirror Shield...
A beautiful, glimmering shield capable
of reflecting monsters' shots.
You can use it to turn their
attacks back at them.
Or so they say...
But it's just a rumor...
{Choice:03:10}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Swiftbladuv drbarsky kout
Zrcadlovy stıt...
Krasny, zarici stıt schopny
odrazet strely netvoru.
Muzes jim vratit jejich
utoky zpatky.
Nebo se to aspon povida...
Ale je to jen drb...
{Choice:03:10}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Swiftblade, Signing Off!
Issue 2 is out the door!
We've got our first reader letter!
Let's answer it now!
"Hey, Swiftblade, what's your best
feature?"
That would be my eyebrows! I spend
a lot of time grooming these suckers!
See you in issue 3!
Until next time, warriors!
cz:
Swiftblade se louci!
Cislo 2 je venku!
Mame prvni ctenarsky dopis!
Pojdme na nej odpovedet!
"Hej, Swiftblade, jaka je tvoje
nejlepsi vlastnost?"
To by bylo moje oboci! Travim
spoustu casu jeho upravou!
Uvidime se v cisle 3!
Do prıste, valecnici!

en:
Swordsman Newsletter {Symbol:10}3{Color:Green}
    {Color:White}Got a Bone to Pick?
You're sure to run into more than
a few skeletons on your journey.
That's why this week's newsletter is
dedicated to all you bone-breakers!
A good, solid whack to the head should
do the trick. That's their weak spot!
Try smacking them with a beam
from your {Color:Red}Cane of Pacci{Color:White}.
You should also try your {Color:Red}Gust Jar{Color:White}.
That head should just pop right off!
They go all to pieces once they
lose their head.
{Choice:03:12}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Sermirsky zpravodaj {Symbol:10}3{Color:Green}
    {Color:White}Mas s nekym konflikt?
Urcite na ceste potkas vıc
nez par koster.
Proto je tento tydennik venovan
vsem lamacum kosti!
Poradny tresk do hlavy by mel
zabrat. To je jejich slabina!
Zkus je sahnout paprskem
{Color:Red}Hole Pacci{Color:White}.
Muzes zkusit i {Color:Red}Vichrnici{Color:White}.
Ta hlava by mela odletet!
Kdyz prijdou o hlavu, hned
se rozsypou.
{Choice:03:12}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Teach us, Teacher!
Those darn Bob-ombs!
If you hit them with your sword, they'll
run all over the place and explode!
But don't you worry. This newsletter's
here to teach you how to cope!
Your best bet is arrows!
One shot can take them down!
You can fire from a safe distance,
too! There's also your Gust Jar...
Draw them in and shoot them out, and
they'll even blow up whatever they hit!
{Choice:03:13}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Nauc nas, ucitelı!
Ti proklati Bob-omby!
Kdyz je seknes mecem, rozutecou se
vsude a vybuchnou!
Ale neboj se. Tento zpravodaj
te nauci, jak na ne!
Nejlepsi jsou sıpy!
Jeden vystrel je slozi!
Muzes strilet z bezpecne
vzdalenosti! A taky Vichrnice...
Nasaj je a vystrel je ven a
vybuchnou tam, kam dopadnou!
{Choice:03:13}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Swiftblade's Gossip Column
Light Arrows are amazing...
They go through grass!
They fell a monster with one strike!
They're handy! They're dandy!
They're a super-duper-ultra-item!
Or so it seems...
But it's just a rumor...
{Choice:03:14}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Swiftbladuv drbarsky kout
Svetelne sıpy jsou uzasne...
Projdou travou!
Sloziji netvora jednou ranou!
Jsou sikovne! Jsou parade!
Jsou super-duper-ultra-predmet!
Nebo se to aspon zda...
Ale je to jen drb...
{Choice:03:14}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Swiftblade, Signing Off!
We've got more reader mail this week!
"Hey, Swiftblade! How many siblings
do you have?"
There are nine of us, not counting
the ghost of Swiftblade the First.
I'm the oldest, but again, that's if you
don't count Swiftblade the First!
See you in issue 4!
Until next time, warriors!!!!
cz:
Swiftblade se louci!
Tento tyden mame dalsi posty!
"Hej, Swiftblade! Kolik mas
sourozencu?"
Je nas devet, nepocitam-li
ducha Swiftbladea Prvniho.
Jsem nejstarsi, ovsem zase jen kdyz
nepocitam Swiftbladea Prvniho!
Uvidime se v cisle 4!
Do prıste, valecnici!!!!

en:
Swordsman Newsletter {Symbol:10}4
    Seek Out the Strong!
Have you ever seen a golden monster?

When you fuse Kinstone pieces, you
might get the rare chance to meet one.
They're much stronger than the
regular version of that monster.
Of course, if you beat one of 'em,
you'll get something REALLY good!
If you see one, go fight it instantly!
Just drop everything and go!
{Choice:03:16}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Sermirsky zpravodaj {Symbol:10}4
    Hledej silne!
Videl jsi nekdy zlateho netvora?

Kdyz spojis kousky Kamenu osudu, mas
vzacnou sanci nektereho potkat.
Jsou mnohem silnejsi nez
bezna verze toho netvora.
Samozrejme, kdyz jednoho porazis,
dostanes neco fakt dobreho!
Kdyz nektereho uvidıs, jdi hned bojovat!
Vsechno hod za hlavu a bez!
{Choice:03:16}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Teach us, Teacher!{Color:Green}
{Color:White}  Coping with a Thorny Situation
Those thorny little thorn monsters!
Your sword doesn't hurt 'em at all!
But if you bump 'em with your
{Color:Red}shield {Color:White}up, they'll totally flip!
There are other ways, though.
Flip 'em with a {Color:Red}bomb{Color:White}!
Or your {Color:Red}Cane of Pacci{Color:White}!
Or with a well-placed {Color:Red}Down Thrust{Color:White}!{Color:Blue}
{Color:White}How's that for options? Your head must
be swimming at the possibilities!
{Choice:03:17}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Nauc nas, ucitelı!{Color:Green}
{Color:White}  Reseni trnite situace
Ta mala trniva monstra!
Mec jim vubec nevadi!
Ale kdyz do nich strcis se
zvednutym {Color:Red}stıtem{Color:White}, prevratis je!
Jsou ale i jine zpusoby.
Prevrat je {Color:Red}bombou{Color:White}!
Nebo {Color:Red}Holı Pacci{Color:White}!
Nebo dobre miren {Color:Red}Spodni vypad{Color:White}!{Color:Blue}
{Color:White}Co takove moznosti? Hlava ti
uz urcite jede z tech moznosti!
{Choice:03:17}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Swiftblade's Gossip Column
Remote Bombs...
Here's a secret: you can blow them up
whenever you want! How cool is that?!
Or so it seems...
But it's just a rumor...
{Choice:03:18}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Swiftbladuv drbarsky kout
Dalkove bomby...
Tajemstvi: muzes je odpalit
kdykoli chces! Neni to skvele?!
Nebo se to aspon zda...
Ale je to jen drb...
{Choice:03:18}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Swiftblade, Signing Off!
I went to {Color:Green}Lon Lon Ranch {Color:White}the other day.
I saw the ghost of Swiftblade the First
defeat a cow with his bare hands!
It was kind of sad, really...

See you in issue 5!
Until next time, warriors!!!!
cz:
Swiftblade se louci!
Nedavno jsem byl na {Color:Green}rancı Lon Lon{Color:White}.
Videl jsem ducha Swiftbladea Prvniho,
jak holyma rukama porazi kravu!
Bylo to vlastne dost smutne...

Uvidime se v cisle 5!
Do prıste, valecnici!!!!

en:
Swordsman Newsletter {Symbol:10}5
    Fire Up That Chilly Chump!
Have you seen a sorcerer who throws
cold curses at you?
Yeah, the one who keeps disappearing!
That's him!
Well, next time he shows up, whack him
with your lantern!
Fire against ice!
It's the law of nature!
{Choice:03:1A}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Sermirsky zpravodaj {Symbol:10}5
    Zapal toho mraziveho hlupaka!
Videl jsi carodeje, ktery na tebe
hazi ledove kletby?
Jo, ten co porad mizı! To je on!

Tak az se prıste objevi, prasti
ho lampou!
Ohen proti ledu!
To je prirodni zakon!
{Choice:03:1A}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Teach us, Teacher!
Those pig-faced Moblins...
You see them around the Minish Woods,
right? They're big and dumb?
Well, they're also rich!
{Color:Blue}Beat one up for some quick cash!{Color:White}
{Choice:03:1B}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Nauc nas, ucitelı!
Ti prasecı Moblinove...
Vidıs je v lesıch Minish, vid?
Jsou velcı a hloupı?
Ano, ale taky bohatı!
{Color:Blue}Zmlat jednoho a budes mit hotovost!{Color:White}
{Choice:03:1B}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Swiftblade's Gossip Column
A tidbit about amulets...
I hear that there's a mysterious amulet
that raises your abilities if you use it!
Well, that's what I heard, anyway...
But it's just a rumor...
{Choice:03:1C}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Swiftbladuv drbarsky kout
Drobnost o amuletech...
Slysel jsem, ze existuje zahadny
amulet, ktery zvysi tve schopnosti!
No, to jsem aspon slysel...
Ale je to jen drb...
{Choice:03:1C}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Swiftblade, Signing Off!
I went to Smith's the other day.
The old guy's still looking pretty good.
... ...
But I AM a little concerned about the
{Color:Blue}guy in green tights {Color:White}on the hill there...
See you in issue 6!
Until next time, warriors!!!!
cz:
Swiftblade se louci!
Nedavno jsem byl u Smithe.
Stary panek porad vypada dobre.
... ...
Ale malinko se starosti o
{Color:Blue}chlapika v zelenych puncochach{Color:White} na kopci...
Uvidime se v cisle 6!
Do prıste, valecnici!!!!

en:
Swordsman Newsletter {Symbol:10}6
    Here's What You Do!
Have you seen a monster wrapped in
bandages? It tries to grab you?
Well, here's a pro tip: {Color:Blue}bandages burn{Color:White}
easily, especially on a mummy!
I don't have to spell this out, do I?
Yeah, you know what I'm about to say!
That's right, it's time to light up
their world! FWOOOSH!
{Choice:03:1E}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Sermirsky zpravodaj {Symbol:10}6
    Tady mas, co delat!
Videl jsi netvora obvazaneho
v obvazech? Snazi se te chytit?
Profı tip: {Color:Blue}obvazy snadno horı{Color:White},
zvlast na mumii!
Nemusim to dal vysvetlovat, ze?
Jo, vıs, co reknu!
Presne tak, je cas rozzarit
jim den! WHOOOOO!
{Choice:03:1E}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Teach us, Teacher!
Those heavy-handed Floor Masters...
And their irritating friends,
the Wall Masters...
They're really annoying, but if you
beat one, they say you'll be rich!!
But it's just a rumor... Don't complain
to me if it turns out to be wrong.
{Choice:03:1F}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Nauc nas, ucitelı!
Ti tezkopadnı Floor Masteri...
A jejich otravnı kamaradi,
Wall Masteri...
Jsou fakt nepriejmnı, ale kdyz
jednoho porazis, prej zbohatnes!!
Ale je to jen drb... Nestezuj si
u me, kdyz to vyjde naprazno.
{Choice:03:1F}Cist dal  {Choice:FF}To staci

en:
Swiftblade's Gossip Column
Rupee-stealing nasties...
Those Rupee-camouflaged creeps have
been ripping a lot of you off lately.
I've heard that you greedy
adventurers are getting soaked!
In fact, I hear that the greedier
you are, the more it takes!
Or so it seems...
But it's just a rumor...
{Choice:03:20}Continue reading  {Choice:FF}That's enough
cz:
Swiftbladuv drbarsky kout

Ti netvori maskovaní jako rupie

Slysel jsem, ze vy hamoun-stı
dobrodruzi to schytavate!
Dokonce slysim, ze cım jsi
hamounstejsi, tım vıc ti vezme!
Nebo se to aspon zda...
Ale je to jen drb...

en:
Swiftblade, Signing Off!
We've got reader mail again!
"Hey, Swiftblade, do you have
a hobby?"
Training!

See you in issue 7!
Until next time, warriors!!!!
cz:
Swiftblade se louci!
Zase mame ctenarskou postu!
"Hej, Swiftblade, mas nejaky
konıcek?"
Trening!

Uvidime se v cisle 7!
Do prıste, valecnici!!!!

en:
Swordsman Newsletter {Symbol:10}7
    For Real Swordsmen Only
You know the Roll Attack, right?
